name: Mahjong G-taste
source:
Inspired by the erotic Yagami Hiroki manga, an anthology of sexy situations featuring all types of girls.

Meet Moe, Nana, Mai, Sayaka, Misuzu, Asuka and Yuna, the sexiest girls around, but they have a common problem to each other: They can't get enough sex and get satisfied. They will do anything they can to accomplish their dreams and desires.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=1976]ANN[/url]]

靈感來自八神宏樹的色情漫畫，一部彙集各種類型女孩性感場景的合集。
